subject: convoyHauler
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: armoured convoy hauler guarding a sealed cargo pod.
Style: low-poly cyberpunk.
reasoning:
I'm planning a compact but detailed static vehicle build, aiming for an 8-wheel hauler truck made from boxes and wheel parts, keeping the API usage simple and safe.

Working out the detailed dimensions — chassis, cab, cargo pod with hazard bands and glowing seams, plus wheel placement and underglow/texture details — before writing the actual construction code.

Writing vehicle construction code...

Still writing pod details... I'll cap the pod ends with scaled spheres, add hazard-colored rings and glow seams, and maybe throw in a roof turret with a base, body, and barrel for the cab.

Now I'm laying out the cab and hood dimensions, figuring out their positions along the z-axis so the chassis length works out, and placing the axles at specific z-coordinates to match. Then I move on to the windshield, planning it as a dark glass panel.
